nodes.odprawa.text.t: "I carry what they give me, farm boy. Leave the questions to the clerks. At least they take coin for it." The courier turns his back on you, cloak snapping.

nodes.podsluch_ok.text.t: From the talk by the horse you catch scraps: "…to the capital… names written in… and when they come back?" – "Come back?" And they both guffaw. Nobody says a word about the road home.

nodes.podsluch_zle.text.t: The courier catches you eavesdropping and gives you a black look. "Boy, you'll want those ears yet. Keep them out of other men's business."

nodes.pokora.text.t: "Spoken like a man who knows he's only got the one head." Gnieworad nods approvingly, and the courier doesn't look at you again.

nodes.przybycie.text.t: The courier in the red cloak drops out of the saddle and pulls a scroll with the imperial seal from inside his coat. Gnieworad reads it in silence, jaw clenched. Meanwhile the courier looks the pupils over like a cattle dealer at a fair.

nodes.pyskowka.text.t: "Wants to be asked, does he!" Gnieworad snorts, but the corner of his mouth twitches. "Nobody asks you, same as nobody asks a horse what cart it's going to pull. Still, it's good you've got a mouth on you, damn it."

nodes.tresc.text.t: The courier snorts, but talks, since the order's no secret. "The Emperor wants young recruits in the capital. Four from this hovel, names already on the list. An honour, say the ones who stay at home."
